import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from tests.unit.chaine.environnement import RACINE_DEPOT, DATE_GENERATION, DATE_ARRETE, horloge_pas_a_pas
from tests.unit.chaine.test_execution import _executer
from usine.composition import construire_rapport, generer_journal
from usine.config import charger_yaml
from usine.contrats.config import ConfigProgramme
from usine.consultation.passage import ConsultationPassage

def test_x(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    shutil.copytree(RACINE_DEPOT / "config", tmp_path / "config")
    shutil.copytree(RACINE_DEPOT / "gabarits", tmp_path / "gabarits")
    p = charger_yaml(tmp_path / "config" / "programme.yaml", ConfigProgramme)
    generer_journal(p, 42, DATE_GENERATION, tmp_path)
    r = construire_rapport(tmp_path)
    m, e = _executer(r, date_arrete=DATE_ARRETE)
    c = ConsultationPassage(e.repertoire_publie)
    for pr in c.previsions():
        if pr.date_arrete == DATE_ARRETE: print("PREV", pr.entite, pr.statut, pr.date_sortie_estimee)
    for k in c.risques():
        if k.date_arrete == DATE_ARRETE: print("RISK", k.entite, k.indicateur)
    for mt in c.meteo(DATE_ARRETE): print("MET", mt.entite, mt.couleur)
    print(min(x.date_arrete for x in c.previsions()))
EOF
